annotations.title: A game's lowest listed price, with every offer

description: Answer "where is this game cheapest?" in the reader's market, in one call: `answer` is the lowest listed price among the stores we checked, the offer the game's page quotes, and `offers` is every tracked offer behind it. Pass the game's name as `title`, as the reader typed it, or its `slug` from search_games, find_games or list_deals; `platform` (pc, xbox, playstation, switch, or one storefront or console such as steam or ps5) and `edition` (deluxe, gold, standard) narrow it. A title that matches several products, such as editions, a remaster and its original or two games of one name, returns `needsChoice: true` with `candidates` and no price, so the reader can be asked which one before any price is quoted. Otherwise `answer.winner` gives the seller and whether it is an official store or a marketplace, the key's activation region (it activates in the market), the currency the seller charges and the price, `lastChecked`, and the page link; `answer.byPlatform` has each platform's own lowest, and `answer.summary` says it all in one sentence that can be quoted as it stands. `feesKnown: false` means the listed price may not include the seller's checkout fees. A price in another currency than the market's is kept and not converted (a euro key that activates in Brazil), and `currencyNote` says so. A free-to-play game, or one with no in-stock key confirmed to activate in the market, has no price, and `answer.status` and `answer.summary` say which. Prices hold as of `lastChecked`: only a price in a current result is ours to quote. `offers` follow the page's order, official stores first and then marketplaces, each by listed price, so the first offer is not always the lowest; an unknown slug or title returns an error result. Links go through getcheapgames.com and carry the stores' partner tracking; listed prices exclude the service fee marketplaces add at checkout.

country.description: Two-letter market code, any case, e.g. de, gb, us, br or pl (43 markets). It decides the currency prices come back in, which keys count as region-locked, and the market every link opens in. Omitted or unsupported codes fall back to ie (Ireland, euro).

edition.description: The edition, e.g. "deluxe", "gold", "game of the year" or "standard" (the plain game). Omit for the product the title or slug names.

platform.description: Only keys for this platform: pc, xbox, playstation or switch (every PC launcher, every PlayStation...), or one storefront or console such as steam, epic, gog, ps5, ps4 or switch 2. Omit for every platform, with each one's own lowest in answer.byPlatform.

slug.description: The game's slug, lower-case with hyphens, e.g. "elden-ring": the `slug` field of a search, deals or finder result, or of a needsChoice candidate. Give `slug` or `title`.

title.description: The game's name as a person types it, e.g. "elden ring" or "Assassin's Creed Shadows": matched as the site's search matches it. Give `title` or `slug`.

name: get_game_offers

answer.description: The lowest listed price among the stores we checked; null with needsChoice.

activation.description: The key's region as sold, and the market it activates in.

checkoutFee.description: A decimal amount such as 19.99, in the game's `currency`.

currencyNote.description: Set when the seller charges in another currency than the market's.

feesKnown.description: False: the listed price may not include checkout fees.

summary.description: One sentence to quote: the price, seller, region, fees, currency and when it was checked.

activation.description: The key's region as sold, and the market it activates in.

checkoutFee.description: A decimal amount such as 19.99, in the game's `currency`.

currencyNote.description: Set when the seller charges in another currency than the market's.

feesKnown.description: False: the listed price may not include checkout fees.

best.description: The lowest listed price of an in-stock key that activates in the market; null for a free game or when none does (`bestNote` says which).

needsChoice.description: True when the title or edition matches several products: `candidates` lists them and there is no price.

checkoutFee.description: Whether a fee is added at checkout.

pricesByPlatform.description: Lowest price per platform, e.g. {"PC": "19.99 EUR"}.
